BackstoryDef.title: hollow-floor grub
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in the damp dark under a house floor, one of a colony that had moved in beneath the boards, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days eating whatever the workers brought back.

BackstoryDef.title: scuttling devil bug
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew up quick on {PAWN_possessive} feet, scouting the dark edges of the hive by smell and dragging back under the floor whatever the colony asked for.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel child
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in a nest deep underground and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days hauling spoil along the tunnels and following the scent trails of the workers.

BackstoryDef.title: tireless giant ant
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} worked the nest from dawn to dark, cutting tunnels through solid rock and carrying loads far heavier than herself, and came home each night to the man the nest had taken for her.

BackstoryDef.title: shell grub
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched with {PAWN_possessive} shell already hard, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days in the leaf litter drinking sap while the armour thickened.

BackstoryDef.title: lancer soldier beetle
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a lancer of her kind, silent in the ranks, quick to duel for the place she wanted, and slow to leave the man she picked.

BackstoryDef.title: munching greenworm
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched as a soft green grub among the hive's egg sacs, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days eating, sleeping and eating again, storing up everything {PAWN_possessive} body would need later.

BackstoryDef.title: still-hungry greenworm
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} never spun a chrysalis and never grew wings, staying soft and slow and hungry all day, eating whatever the hive's stores can spare.

BackstoryDef.title: nectar-fed wriggler
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in the standing water at the bottom of the hive, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days drinking nectar, learning to hold still in the air, and watching the workers come and go.

BackstoryDef.title: prowling vamp mosquito
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into the hive's huntress, circling a man for hours before she strikes and leaving a mark that brings him back to her long after he has gone.

BackstoryDef.title: sealed swarm princess
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} slept sealed deep underground for ages, one of the daughters kept for the day the swarm would be wanted again.

BackstoryDef.title: swarm-mother abaddon
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} woke under an open sky and the swarm woke with her, flying where her scent told it to fly and taking the men she chose.

BackstoryDef.title: swarm grub
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in the middle of a swarm in flight, one of thousands of small hard bodies, and learned to follow the scent of her elders before she learned anything else.

BackstoryDef.title: soldier bug of the swarm
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} took her place in the ranks and never left it, fighting where the pheromones told her to fight and answering to the swarm until she took a man of her own.

BackstoryDef.title: web-nursery spiderling
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in a web the size of a room, one of many small bodies in it, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days learning which strands would hold her weight and which would not.

BackstoryDef.title: silk-spinning arachne
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} spins the silk her hive dresses itself in, and meets every bite and sting she earns with the same strange patience - she goes back to the same man for more.

BackstoryDef.title: midden maggot
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in the warm rot the swarm leaves behind it, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days eating what nobody else would touch and growing fat on it.

BackstoryDef.title: gorged beelzebub
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into the swarm's glutton, quick on her own wings and always hungry, drinking her fill from whatever the hive brings down and keeping a man close enough to drink from.

BackstoryDef.title: sand-buried stingling
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched under the sand and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days buried in it, learning to hold still while the whole desert walked past above her.

BackstoryDef.title: venomed girtablilu
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hunts the desert alone at night, charging down whatever she has decided to take and leaving a venom in it that finishes the argument - and then goes home to the man she marked the same way.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel-raised mimic
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in the tunnels of a colony that was not hers by blood, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days carrying whatever was put in front of her, learning the whole nest by feel before she could speak.

BackstoryDef.title: many-handed ant arachne
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} does the work of four of her sisters at once, cutting, carrying and mending whatever the hive asks for, and keeps the man she chose as busy as she keeps herself.

BackstoryDef.title: comb-raised bee
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in a comb in the hive's warm dark, fed by her sisters from the day she hatched, and grew up with the smell of honey in everything she knew.

BackstoryDef.title: honey-heavy bee
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} keeps the hive's fields and its animals, filling with honey as she works them, and gives away the sweet part of everything she brings home.

BackstoryDef.title: lamplit grub
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in a dark corner of the hive and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days crawling toward the nearest lamp, sitting under it for hours, and listening to the grown women talk.

BackstoryDef.title: moth of the lamps
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} keeps the hive's lamps and its records, sits up late talking with whoever is awake, and is happy in a way her sisters quietly envy.

BackstoryDef.title: flower-row child
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched among the hive's flower rows and was raised by whichever sister was nearest, learning every face in the village before she could walk.

BackstoryDef.title: hive butterfly
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is the one the hive sends to do the talking, because everyone talks back to her. She reads, she remembers, and she is careful to be nowhere near a fight.

BackstoryDef.title: barracks grub
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in the hive's outer comb, where the fighters are raised, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days watching the drills and picking fights with her sisters.

BackstoryDef.title: hive wasp
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} stands in the hive's line, quick on her feet and quicker to sting, and quarrels with every honey bee she passes.
